measurement_source_continuity.meaning: Historical authority/effect measurements remain bound to their original source. Retained domain admission deltas are inherited from the predecessor. Listed currentness changes replace repeated full cover validation with validated immutable facts and capture/recheck external identities. Library and Attention use the existing application owner; generation-local accepted browse lifetimes drain through final recheck. One persistent-root coordinator gives waiting foreground local operations the next fair safe boundary without retaining admission over external I/O. Explicit effect/reviewer local boundaries preserve durable claims, revision checks and failure behavior. Policy publishes only after durable Settings commit. Decision acknowledgements include validated current-case confirmation or truthful unavailable readback; same-case browser commands serialize through validated adoption. Concrete Query completion debt preserves freshness without cancelling in-flight foreground reads; timer ticks alone create no debt. Disconnected queued collection reads skip execution. Preparation output uses nonblocking acquisition of its existing claim gate and atomically queues a successor when busy; leases and recovery remain unchanged. Current consumer tests establish these changed behavior and binding contracts, not new historical quality measurement. The derived column requires clean rebuild. Historical source members remain, new consumers extend the closure, and only the five original named assignments receive cycle-breaking AST comparison. #1085 extends the current behavior with before-release committed claim handoff, nonblocking extraction publication admission, contained subscriber wakes, runtime recovery stop and closed diagnostics, and opt-in ordinary Linux root crash admission. Original database and journal bytes are retained until a byte-verified private copy passes native rollback and exact-current validation. These changes have current consumer proof and do not remeasure historical metadata quality. No schema or automatic option change is introduced. #1073 binds unchanged-title witnesses, Automatic-only coherence and explicit recovery of completed current title projections. Current synthetic tests prove transaction and lifecycle behavior; historical quality counters are unchanged.
